ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: The diagram below shows the life cycle of a lizard. Which stage is shown at B?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows several lizards arranged from left to right, gradually becoming larger in body size. The letter A is located near the smallest young lizard on the left side; the letter B is located near the largest lizard at the lower right, whose body and limbs are fully developed. Reasoning: The question asks which stage of the lizard life cycle B represents. In an animal life cycle, the largest and fully developed individual represents the adult stage. Therefore, B is the adult stage.
